title: The cell that heals itself without trusting the backup
story: Hostile RF jamming targets an emulated satellite backhaul link while ORCA rejects an unverified candidate route and safely fails over to a verified Indian gateway.
human_decisions: Commander rejects unverified trap path A despite immediate availability.
Commander enforces Indian gateway requirement blocking foreign route proposal GW-XX.
Commander approves PB-06 execution exclusively on verified domestic path B.

objective.what: Tower CHN-03 fails over from jammed primary link to clean verified domestic route.

schedule.what: M1 flags an abrupt SNR drop and packet loss on primary satellite backhaul at CHN-03.
M2 forecasts complete loss of primary satellite link margin.
M3 confirms clear local weather and classifies degradation as active RF jamming.
Mobile operator proposes candidate path A for immediate failover.
Satellite operator finds candidate path A fails integrity verification.
Gap Analyst audits statutory failover path security verification rules.
Gap Analyst audits mandatory cyber security standards for satellite failover.
Satellite operator verifies clean domestic candidate path B via GW-IN-2.
Commander rejects unverified path A and foreign path C, approving PB-06 on verified domestic path B.
M1 confirms recovery of cell site backhaul over path B.
